task_completion.description: Navigate to Microsoft Edge settings and enable 'Choose a service provider' under Security.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshot showing Edge Settings > Privacy, search, and services, with 'Use secure DNS' toggled on and a custom provider field visible.

task_completion.description: Configure Cloudflare (1.1.1.1) as the DNS-over-HTTPS provider.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Edge settings page showing 'Cloudflare (1.1.1.1)' selected from the dropdown or the URL 'https://chrome.cloudflare-dns.com/dns-query' entered in the custom field.

task_completion.description: Visit the Cloudflare help page to verify the connection.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The browser address bar showing 'https://1.1.1.1/help' or 'https://one.one.one.one/help'.

task_completion.description: The verification page confirms that DNS-over-HTTPS is active.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The webpage content showing 'Using DNS over HTTPS (DoH)' with a 'Yes' status next to it.

task_completion.description: Save the screenshot of the verification page to the specified path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file manager window or terminal output showing 'doh_verification.png' exists in /home/ga/Desktop/.

task_completion.description: Create the text file with the required content.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal 'cat' command showing the file /home/ga/Desktop/doh_status.txt contains the exact string 'DoH Active: Yes'.

integrity.description: The agent used the Edge GUI to configure settings rather than modifying config files via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the mouse cursor interacting with the Edge settings menu and dropdowns.

integrity.description: The agent visited the actual Cloudflare help site rather than spoofing a local HTML file.
integrity.visual_evidence: The browser address bar shows the live URL (1.1.1.1/help) and not a 'file://' path.

integrity.description: The text file content matches the live state of the browser verification.
integrity.visual_evidence: The 'DoH Active: Yes' in the text file corresponds to the 'Yes' shown on the browser screen in the same trajectory.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The official Cloudflare DoH endpoint for Edge/Chrome is 'https://chrome.cloudflare-dns.com/dns-query'. The verification page at https://1.1.1.1/help must specifically show 'Using DNS over HTTPS (DoH): Yes' for the task to be successful. The files must be saved in /home/ga/Desktop/.
